sloka: स राजा पृथिवीं सर्वां वशे कृत्वा सुधार्मिकः ।राज्यं चैव नरव्याघ्र पुत्रवत्पर्यपालयत् ।। ७.८७.४ ॥
transliteration: sa rājā pṛthivīṁ sarvāṁ vaśe kṛtvā sudhārmikaḥ ।rājyaṁ caiva naravyāghra putravatparyapālayat ।। 7.87.4 ॥

translations.english: That very righteous king, having brought the entire earth under his control, protected his kingdom as if it were his own son, O tiger among men.
